{"analysis":"Comparing candidate platforms against selection criteria reveals three distinct architectural tradeoffs. DeepAgents, built on LangGraph (source_001), inherits a graph state machine model suited to complex multi-step workflows (source_002). This gives strong control over execution paths and checkpointing, but adds framework overhead and a steeper learning curve; teams must accept LangGraph's abstractions even for simple agent loops. Pydantic AI emphasizes typed tool definitions and structured outputs (source_003), which improves reliability of model-tool contracts and reduces schema drift, but it does not by itself provide workflow orchestration; complex routing or stateful pipelines would need to be layered on top. DeepSeek Harness is explicitly reserved for the outer validation environment (source_004), meaning it is not a general-purpose agent platform candidate but a harness for evaluating deployed agents. This separation is a tradeoff: it keeps validation isolated from production code, but it cannot be selected as the primary runtime. The benchmark design reports quality, cost, and critical-path latency (source_007), so any platform choice must expose these three dimensions; platforms that obscure per-step cost or latency make evaluation harder. A key research gap is that existing LLM routing work mostly selects one model per request (source_005), so platforms offering fine-grained per-step routing would differentiate themselves, but none of the cited candidates demonstrates this capability. Static task decomposition belongs to the application layer (source_006), which shifts responsibility away from the platform: teams must build decomposition themselves, reducing the value of platform-level orchestration claims. The scoring rubric weights requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, analysis depth, structure and readability, and HTML validity (source_008), so the final comparison must map each platform to explicit criteria rather than relying on vendor narratives. 2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型

Executive Summary

2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型需在 DeepAgents、Pydantic AI 与 DeepSeek Harness 之间权衡。DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph [source_001]，适合复杂多步工作流但引入框架耦合；Pydantic AI 提供类型化工具定义与结构化输出 [source_003]，却缺乏编排能力；DSH 仅用于外部验证环境 [source_004]，不能作为生产运行时。基准要求报告质量、成本与关键路径延迟 [source_007]，且现有路由研究多为单模型选择 [source_005]，尚无平台完全满足全部标准。

Background

企业 Agent 平台需支持多步推理、工具调用与可观测评估。LangGraph 作为图状态机框架支撑复杂工作流 [source_002]，DeepAgents 构建于其上 [source_001]。Pydantic AI 侧重类型化工具定义与结构化输出 [source_003]，降低模型-工具契约漂移。DeepSeek Harness 被限定为外部验证环境 [source_004]，用于隔离评估而非承载生产负载。静态任务分解归属应用层 [source_006]，平台编排能力因此受限。

Selection Criteria

选型标准包括工作流编排能力、类型安全、验证隔离、可观测性与路由灵活性。基准设计明确要求报告质量、成本与关键路径延迟 [source_007]，平台必须暴露这三个维度。评分规则权重涵盖需求覆盖、证据准确性、分析深度、结构与可读性及 HTML 有效性 [source_008]。此外，现有 LLM 路由研究多为整请求单模型选择 [source_005]，细粒度逐步路由能力应作为差异化加分项。

Platform Comparison

DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph [source_001]，继承图状态机框架 [source_002]，适合复杂多步工作流，但增加框架开销与学习曲线。Pydantic AI 提供类型化工具定义与结构化输出 [source_003]，提升契约可靠性，但缺乏原生编排。DeepSeek Harness 仅用于外部验证环境 [source_004]，隔离评估与生产代码，但不可作为主运行时。静态任务分解归属应用层 [source_006]，削弱平台编排价值；三者均未展示逐步路由能力 [source_005]。

Risks

主要风险包括框架耦合、编排缺失与验证边界误用。DeepAgents 依赖 LangGraph 抽象 [source_001][source_002]，简单 Agent 循环也需承担框架开销。Pydantic AI 无工作流编排 [source_003]，复杂路由需应用层自建，而静态任务分解本就归属应用层 [source_006]。DSH 若被误作生产运行时将破坏验证隔离 [source_004]。基准要求质量、成本与关键路径延迟 [source_007]，平台若掩盖逐步成本或延迟将导致评估失真。

Conclusion

无单一平台完全满足全部标准。DeepAgents 适合复杂工作流但耦合 LangGraph [source_001][source_002]；Pydantic AI 适合类型安全但缺编排 [source_003]；DSH 仅作验证边界 [source_004]。基准的质量-成本-延迟三元组 [source_007] 与单模型路由缺口 [source_005] 表明，企业需在平台之上补充应用层分解 [source_006] 与逐步路由，并按评分规则 [source_008] 映射显式标准。

References

judge.rationale: The report demonstrates excellent requirement coverage with all seven required sections (Executive Summary, Background, Selection Criteria, Platform Comparison, Risks, Conclusion, References) present and substantive. Structure and readability are excellent with logical flow and clear section organization.
